# Predicates Go queries that nothing produces.
#
# Each of these returns zero rows on every call. Zero rows is also what a
# legitimately empty kernel returns, so the caller cannot tell the two apart
# and neither can anyone reading its output.
#
# Regenerate: CODENERD_UPDATE_QUERY_ONLY=1 go test ./internal/core/defaults/ -run TestGoQueriedPredicateBudget
# See query_only_predicate_test.go for why this is a budget rather than a
# target of zero.
#
# Adding a line is an admission, not a fix. Ask first whether the producer is
# genuinely external -- an operator-supplied fact, an optional integration --
# or whether the wiring is simply missing, which is what test_result was.
#
# Format: predicate<TAB>the file(s) querying it.
#
# internal/orient/report.go queries judgments derived by internal/orient/*.mg.
# This gate's corpus walk is internal/core/defaults only, so those rule heads
# are not visible to it. The producers are the rules, not an external feed.
code_edit_outcome	internal/autopoiesis/autopoiesis_kernel.go
cold_storage_entry	cmd/nerd/cmd_systems.go
compressed_context	cmd/nerd/cmd_systems.go
cyclomatic_complexity	internal/campaign/edge_case_detector.go internal/campaign/edge_case_detector.go
doc_evolved_into	internal/orient/report.go
doc_superseded	internal/orient/report.go
knowledge_edge	cmd/nerd/cmd_systems.go
learned_pattern	cmd/nerd/cmd_systems.go
module_northstar	internal/northstar/module.go
module_requirement	internal/northstar/module.go
origin_source	internal/orient/report.go
requirement_task_link	cmd/nerd/chat/model_session_context.go
repo_era	internal/init/phase_orient.go internal/orient/report.go
safety_warning	cmd/nerd/chat/model_session_context.go internal/campaign/intelligence_gathering_methods.go
shard_prompt_base	internal/articulation/prompt_assembler.go
user_requests_appeal	internal/shards/system/constitution.go
vision_source	internal/orient/report.go
